lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in 12-14 discernible vertical columns along the lateral flank, with a higher spatial frequency observed towards the anterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a structured orthogonal grid, creating distinct anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, though horizontal interlacing artifacts limit the precision of individual spot centroid identification.

other_distinctive_markers: Two large commensal organisms (remoras) are attached to the ventral surface, extending posteriorly from the pelvic region.
